captionTemplate.rationale: One burned-in caption style for the whole edit, set once and inherited: white Inter bold on a 55% black box at y=0.72 - inside the 9:16 safe band (out of the top 10% and bottom 20%), below the speakers' faces, high legibility over a talking-head frame. The two punchline captions override fontSize (62) and y (0.70) deliberately so the joke bookends read slightly larger than the build; the two 'hinge' lines override animation to fade so a flat line lands flat.

metadata.rationale: One joke, told twice: cold-open on the punchline with zero setup (0.0-2.25s), hard cut back to the context question and the build-up that makes it mean something (2.25-26.6s), then land on the punchline beat again now that it pays off (26.6-30.0s). Every cut sits on a word boundary so no syllable is clipped; everything that isn't the otter/watch bit is gone. Delivery stays deadpan: no music bed, no rendered transitions, hard cuts only, one neutral grade for the whole edit, no glitch/aberration/blur on faces, and burned-in captions as the only graphic element. The single speed ramp lives on the wordless reaction beat (segment 1) with all keyframes inside its 0.55s source range so the joke breathes without any visual styling. Rhythm still evolves - phase 1 avg 2.15s, phase 2 avg 1.43s (66%), phase 3 avg 1.18s (55%) with the 3.4s payoff hold as the longest shot of the back half.
